name: buywhere
description: Product catalog API built for AI agents — 300M+ products from 900,000+ merchants that want to be discovered (Shopify, WooCommerce, and independent retailers worldwide). Search, compare offers, find deals, and route to merchants. Pass deliver_to (buyer's country) on every search for fast, market-scoped results.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text + semantic product search over 300M+ products. ALWAYS pass deliver_to (buyer's ISO country code) for fast, market-scoped results.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full product details by BuyWhere product ID

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare multiple products side by side

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Find products with active discounts (pass deliver_to)

tools.name: find_best_price
tools.description: Find the best price for a product across merchants (pass deliver_to)

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find similar products to a given product
